name: Sandwich Stack .mm
tagline: Build the tallest sandwich. Timing is everything! (Packaged edition)
rules: Each new layer slides back and forth over your sandwich. Drop it right on top.
Whatever hangs over the edge gets sliced off, so your sandwich gets narrower.
Spot-on drops are perfect, and a streak of them makes it wider again. Miss completely and the top two layers fall off.
Tallest sandwich when the time’s up wins.

controls.keyboard: Space (or click) to drop the layer
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to drop the layer

intro: Drop each layer right on top of the last one!
